Strategy: Refine the distribution-plus-worst-fit family with a mean-shifted peak: target one item above the mean residual, scoring bins by closeness to that target, with a bonus for an exact fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest bin sits below the target while a looser bin sits near it, so a looser bin wins. This may preserve tight bins, but the target can sit beyond the loosest bin and collapse to worst fit.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    mean = sum(bins) / len(bins)
    target = mean + item
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) - abs(r - target) for r in bins]
```
